# v1.3.0-515: Settings and display editor tidy-ups

Builds on `v1.3.0-513`, the Electron 45 release that fixed maximize. Small
layout fixes found by the spacing probe while checking that upgrade.

## Fixes

- In the display editor, each monitor's name and its controls share one
  left edge. They were centred by a few pixels inside the card before.
- On Settings, Companion Software, the cards no longer stretch past a
  readable width on a wide dialog, so the one-line descriptions stay easy
  to read.

## Good to know

- Nothing else changed since `v1.3.0-513`. If you skipped that one, it
  carries the move from Electron 31 to Electron 45 and the maximize fix.
